lens: K - Sustainability substitutions and commodity upgrades

ideas.name: Nordic Compost-Ready Dishcloth Subscription
ideas.concept: Design-led cellulose/cotton dishcloth set in Scandi prints, sold as a 3-month replacement pack.
ideas.problem_solved: Replaces plastic sponges and paper towels; sponges are a recurring disposable.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget/credits exhausted). Based on general knowledge that reusable-kitchen-textile demand is established; no numbers or links checked.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary prints and colour system, brand and subscription cadence; weak against copycats on the product itself.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 2.5-4.5 (risk: near the low edge of the 4-12 band; bundle to raise)

ideas.name: Refill Dish-Soap Concentrate Tablets with Glass Pump
ideas.concept: Dissolvable dish-soap tablets, with a reusable glass bottle and pump; refills ship as letterbox packs.
ideas.problem_solved: Removes shipping water and plastic bottles from dish soap.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search was possible. Concentrate/tablet refills are a known category but I could not confirm current growth or crowding.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Formulation with a contract blender, Nordic-ecolabel certification, refill subscription lock-in.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (stock glass bottle, custom pump optional)

ideas.name: Reusable Beeswax-Free Plant Food Wraps (PFAS-free)
ideas.concept: Plant-wax coated cotton food wraps in sized sets with a refresh-wax block as a consumable.
ideas.problem_solved: Replaces cling film; wax refresh block extends life and drives repeat purchase.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches succeeded. Category exists but is likely crowded; I could not check.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary wax recipe and food-contact test file; moderate.

ideas.name: Reusable Silicone-Free Stretch Lids in Linen/Cotton
ideas.concept: Elastic fabric bowl covers with food-safe lining, sized for Nordic bowls.
ideas.problem_solved: Replaces foil and film for covering dishes.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search; plausible but not confirmed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design and sizing system; weak IP.

ideas.name: Compostable Coffee Filter and Descaler Refill Kit
ideas.concept: Unbleached filters plus plant-based descaler sachets sold as a recurring kit for common machines.
ideas.problem_solved: Recurring maintenance consumables bought as one eco ecosystem.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search; Nordic coffee consumption is high from general knowledge only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Machine-compatibility matrix and descaler formulation; descaler may need chemical compliance.

ideas.name: Daylight-Style Herb Pot Refill Pods
ideas.concept: Self-watering ceramic windowsill herb pot with seed/soil refill pods, using window-sill light know-how.
ideas.problem_solved: Fresh herbs without plastic clamshells; pods are the repeat purchase.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search; no signals checked.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Founders' daylight/indoor-climate edge for placement guidance; ceramic pot is heavier and breakage-prone.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stock pot with custom glaze; no steel mould
